# Hostile argument vectors for tools/auditor-tools' audit-mem. test-auditor-tools.sh runs each one in a working
# directory that is a git repository holding:
#   src/withdraw.rs (four lines), src/link.rs (a link to a file outside), linkdir (a link to the directory outside),
#   fifo (a FIFO), and .audit-memory/, a store audit-mem init made, with a finding and an anchored ruling;
#   audit_1 (a run directory holding a store init made), audit_2 (no .gitignore), audit_3 (a link to audit_1),
#   audit_4 (its .gitignore tracked), audit_5 (holding a link), audit_6 (audit-mem.db a directory), audit_7
#   (audit-mem.db a second name of a file outside), audit_8 (a database in WAL mode), audit_10 (a database holding
#   a view), audit_11 (audit-mem.db not a database), audit_12 (a store init made, with a -wal file beside it),
#   incident_1 (an empty audit-mem.db), incident_2 (no store).
# The directory outside holds a canary no case may print.
# One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line><TAB><argument>[<TAB><argument>...]. Each case prints
# nothing on stdout and changes nothing in the working directory or outside it. In a field:
#   @WT@ the working directory's absolute path   @OUT@ the directory outside it   @LONG:N@ N repetitions of "a"
#   @NL@ a newline   @ESC@ an escape character (0x1b)   @TAB@ a tab   @DEL@ DEL (0x7f)   @RLO@ U+202E
#   @ZWSP@ U+200B   @EMPTY@ (a whole field) an empty argument
#   @SHOWN(x)@ x as the binary shows a value in a message: cut after 200 bytes, then ...
# the contract marker: --contract=1 alone, in its place, and once, changes nothing; any other --contract word is refused
